bear_assumptions: The USD 8.154 billion 2026 revenue-guidance midpoint grows 30% in 2027, free-cash-flow margin normalizes to 42%, and 30x FCF plus USD 7.615 billion net liquid assets is divided by 2.70 billion diluted shares; growth and margins decelerate while stock compensation, dilution and concentration risks persist.
base_assumptions: The USD 8.154 billion 2026 revenue-guidance midpoint grows 45% in 2027, free-cash-flow margin normalizes to 48%, and 45x FCF plus USD 7.615 billion net liquid assets is divided by 2.65 billion diluted shares; commercial and government growth remain exceptional while dilution moderates only gradually.
bull_assumptions: The USD 8.154 billion 2026 revenue-guidance midpoint grows 60% in 2027, free-cash-flow margin holds at 53%, and 60x FCF plus USD 7.615 billion net liquid assets is divided by 2.60 billion diluted shares; category-leading growth and conversion persist while dilution nearly stabilizes, with no value credited to undisclosed Anduril economics.
rating_change_conditions: Upgrade only if a fresh scenario set clears expected-return, base-return, bear/base, expected/bear and margin-of-safety gates at the then-current mark while revenue growth, GAAP profitability, free-cash-flow conversion and dilution-adjusted per-share economics remain sound; downgrade the operating thesis if growth, government or commercial conversion, cash generation, competitive durability or dilution-adjusted economics deteriorate.
